text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Today is the day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well then, trainers, let me hear your
answers. Why do you wish to be
my
trainer?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I'll kick things off.
As I said the other day, I
guarantee you'll become even stronger
under my tutelage—strong enough to
stand on that podium as a champion.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
This is a three-year training plan.
I put all
the knowledge and effort I
could muster
into it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Superb. Even just glancing at it,
I can tell
that it's a well thought out
plan. I'll take a
closer look shortly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Next would be...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Me, yes. It's true that you have boundless
potential—so much so that
some trainers
are hesitant to work with you.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: But I want to see you fulfill your potential. I'm prepared to do whatever it takes to guide you to certain victory!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I've laid out a report with winning race
strategies based on an analysis
of your
runs. Please take a look!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Impressive work. I'll look at it in
more detail shortly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And now... Last but not least,
I turn to you.
Why do you wish to be my
trainer?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You said you wanted to see more of my
running. In other words, you
spoke of your
belief in my future potential.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Illustrate to me, please, what that would
entail. What future would
you seek for
me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In response to her question,
I show her the
photo I took yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Is this... a photograph of me? When I
brought Grass Wonder and
Maruzensky
together?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So this...
is the answer you brought for me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I see. With me, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Symboli Rudolf carefully reads
the documents put together
by the other
trainers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But ultimately...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to turn you both down like this
after you put in so much
work.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: ...A tremendous pity, but I understand.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
We'll leave the rest to you. Help her
achieve greatness—we're
holding you to
that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two trainers look back regretfully as
they make their way off the
track.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
They were excellent trainers. Any student
would flourish under their
guidance.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Why did I choose you? Isn't it obvious?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You made an effort to look at the world
from my perspective. And
that... made me
happier than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What I aim for, every day of my life,
is to create a world where
Umamusume can live
in bliss. That's what I've been running
full-speed toward this entire time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But, well... I think there was a part of
myself that considered it a
naïve, faraway
dream.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But you're different!
I could tell you were
willing to go the extra mile, but I didn't
expect someone who shared the same
vision!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Knowing that brings me so much joy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Having someone who shares my
aspirations—who would seek this future
with me by my side...
it fills my heart with a
reassuring warmth.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Turning the tables on me, are you?
Hahaha! I'm flattered that you feel
that
way!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well then—let's make it official,
shall we?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I am Symboli Rudolf. I stand here at the
starting gate with my eyes on
one goal: a
world where all Umamusume can live in
bliss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But idle talk won't get me anywhere. I
must back my words with deeds
worthy of
attention and respect.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That is why I am aiming for the top—so
that I may be a ruler worthy of
her crown.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Much time has passed since I first came to
the academy. I spent my days serving as
the student council president, but now the
hour is
nigh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Will you help me take the throne, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Excellent. That's what I wanted to hear!
We'll make the name Symboli
Rudolf one
to remember.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Both of us, together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Time passed quickly after that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Soon enough, the day of Symboli Rudolf's
debut race is upon us, and
before I know
it...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your cheers and well-wishes,
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yeaaaaaah! Woooo!!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf—what a powerhouse! Such
an exceptional
performance!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
This victory is surely only the
beginning of
her blazing path to glory!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...High praise indeed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh, looks like we both have great
expectations to live up to!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her smile spreads to the people in the
stands, capturing countless
fans—and this
is still only the first race of her
journey!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: S-so cool!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So that's... Symboli Rudolf!
